user_authorization_scope: Latest user request: implement independent Adapter, fault injection and synthetic noninterference; do not connect production Observer or rerun S07.

interfaces.ObserverAdapter: (directory,mode,identity,total_limit_bytes<=4GiB); creates isolated core and public sink, no automatic activation.
interfaces.FailIsolatedSink: Public record/invalidate/close with independently latched failures and separately guarded core notifications; ordinary backend double faults never enter business handlers.
interfaces.finalize: After business returns, explicit normal_invocation_end and existing receipt path. Idempotent subsequent calls do not retry or rewrite.
interfaces.external_validate: Trusted identity/receipt/expected mode required; default read-only. Exhaust Codec Reader, cross-check event full case/primitive and failures/witness against the existing receipt, resource partition and all root bindings. Explicit publish=True belongs only to separate validator.
interfaces.compare: Require complete B hash_only,C full_capture and full original decoded receipt equality, plus strict streaming Codec comparison with no field exclusions. A/history remains a separate future controller gate.

resource_policy.per_occurrence_copy: Codec only, after its pre-copy checks; no adapter copy or dedup.
resource_policy.quota_limit: Whole-tree conservative/accounted limits and actual allocated bytes, not exclusive disk quota or hard process RSS.

completion.inner: Codec marker in codec/ is necessary but insufficient.
completion.outer: Only independent validator publishes adapter_complete.json after terminal Sink/core flags, identity/mode, receipt, both event pairs, terminal payload and exhausted streaming Reader all agree.
completion.negative_outcome: A fully recorded failed witness is complete evidence, not a qualified patient.
completion.receipt_type_contract: Terminal failures/witness must match the legacy typed JSON list/dict/scalar representation of the frozen JSON receipt. Unsupported or type-losing mismatches hold; no post-hoc type/path normalization.

timing_policy.comparison_library: Cooperative before/after deadline around public Codec.compare; not a hard OS process interrupt. Future external controller must provide hard process deadline.

implementation_notes: Three small standalone modules separate shared pure contracts, typed adapter/sink and external validator; old code unchanged.
Typed _encode matches legacy AST except ndarray delegation; _rng and metadata charging match legacy AST exactly.
No Controller/authorization/deployment implementation in this delivery; no live invocation entry point.
Defensive repeated finalize is idempotent and never a retry, an explicit lifecycle clarification of the design.
Benchmark-only allocated() reporter now de-duplicates index hardlinks by(dev,ino); raw observations retained with an additive correction, not a rerun.
